data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ardehs total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: ארדחס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Ardehs is derived from the Hebrew word ארד (Ard), meaning mountain, and the Hebrew word חס (Chas), meaning God. Therefore, Ardehs can be translated as 'Mountain of God'.

in_greek.name: Αρδείας
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the name Ardehs is Ardeias. The exact meaning of the name in Greek is not explicitly stated in the Bible, but it is mentioned in the New Testament in Acts 15:1. It is believed to be derived from the Hebrew name Ardehs.

in_latin.name: Ardehus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Ardehs is Ardehus. The etymology of the name in Latin is uncertain, but it is believed to be derived from the Hebrew name Ardehs.
